run_post_training_sparse_quantize: run post_training_sparse_quantize to sparsify and quantize embedding modules in a PyTorch model
fetch_all_embeddings: fetch all Embedding and EmbeddingBag modules from a PyTorch model
test_post_training_sparse_quantize: test post_training_sparse_quantize with sparsify_first=True to sparsify then quantize embeddings
refactor_post_training_sparse_quantize: refactor post_training_sparse_quantize to support sparsify_first=False for quantize then sparsify embeddings
review_fetch_all_embeddings: review _fetch_all_embeddings to verify it correctly traverses and returns all embedding modules
